title: Bloody Heaven 2
description:
Bloody Heaven 2 is a rogue-like action game with Rune-build feature. Based on 4 basic actions: light attack, heavy attack, skill and dodge , you will assign runes in your weapon among slots of these 4 actions to build your battle style.

Slash Into HellAs the Revenge Agent of Heaven, you will be able to use more than 3 classes, 12 types of weapon to slash among demons.4 Chapters, over 20 types of monstersGrowing Power of WeaponKill demons to collect gems, and then turn gems into rune inlays for your weapon. The runes could provide various of new abilities to contribute to your battle style.
Death Is BeginningIf you die in a fight, the weapon is also lost with all the runes inlay. Your can start another challenge and if lucky enough, you could find the lost weapon.Permanent UpgradeWin or lose, when you reborn back to heaven, all the gems you collect along the way will turn to dust. Make use of these dust to unlock permanent upgrade.
description_short: Inspired By the well-known rogue-like game Hades, slash out of the God Field all the way down to the Demon Domain and defy The Overlord Thanatos in the Deep Frost Hell in this rogue-like dungeon crawler.
